strings.name: Noam Shazeer
strings.summary: Noam Shazeer contributed to Transformers, sparse mixture-of-experts models and efficient decoding, and previously co-led Google Gemini. He co-founded Character.AI with Daniel De Freitas before returning to Google. In 2026 he announced a move to OpenAI, now listed on his website. His startup history also involves child-safety litigation and corporate bankruptcy proceedings.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Coauthors retained; paper submissions, job announcements and effective dates distinguished. Birth-year sources differ, so it remains unfilled.
strings.influence.rationale: Contributed to Transformer and large neural-network research, advancing language-model efficiency and conversational AI applications.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Duke University class of 1998; studied mathematics and computer science.
strings.facts.f2.label: Early Google work
strings.facts.f2.value: Joined in 2000 and helped improve search spelling correction.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Collaborative Transformer research
strings.highlights.h1.text: With Vaswani and six other authors, proposed an attention-based sequence model, initially tested on tasks including translation.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Model-efficiency research
strings.highlights.h2.text: Worked on sparse mixtures of experts and proposed multi-query attention with shared keys and values to reduce decoding bandwidth.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Co-founded company seeks bankruptcy protection
strings.timeline.t1.text: Character.AI enters Chapter 11 and seeks an asset sale; this is corporate, not Shazeer’s personal bankruptcy.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Announces move to OpenAI
strings.timeline.t2.text: Reuters reports plans to leave Google for OpenAI; the exact departure date was then unconfirmed.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Litigation reaches settlement in principle
strings.timeline.t3.text: The Garcia case involves the company, co-founders and Google; reported settlement terms remain undisclosed, without a liability ruling.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Returns to Google and co-leads Gemini
strings.timeline.t4.text: His return accompanies a Character.AI technology licensing arrangement; he shares technical leadership with Jeff Dean and Oriol Vinyals.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Co-founds Character.AI
strings.timeline.t5.text: Builds the conversational AI company with Daniel De Freitas and serves as CEO; founding year differs from public product launch.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Submits multi-query attention paper
strings.timeline.t6.text: His sole-authored paper proposes shared keys and values and studies speed–quality tradeoffs in incremental decoding.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Submits Transformer paper
strings.timeline.t7.text: Eight authors submit Attention Is All You Need, proposing an attention architecture without recurrence or convolution.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Submits sparse mixture-of-experts paper
strings.timeline.t8.text: With Mirhoseini, Maziarz, Davis, Le, Hinton and Dean, studies conditional computation selecting a subset of experts for each input.
